js.bank_note: All six accounts were reconciled to bank statements on 31 Aug 2026 ({days:n} days ago). Reconciliation for September and October is missing, and about ISK {unb}m of payments for those months are not posted.

open_items.d: {unb_list}.
open_items.nx: Get bank statements for Sep–Oct, post the payments and reconcile the accounts.

open_items.t: VAT settlement account ISK 122.6m in debit
open_items.d: No settlement entries have been made this year. Net VAT payable is {vsk_net}m; Jul–Aug {vsk_julagu}m was due on 5 Oct.
open_items.nx: Confirm the Jul–Aug return and payment with Iceland Revenue, make settlement entries and reconcile to the returns.

open_items.d: The 2025 profit has not been transferred to retained earnings and financial year 2025 is open.
open_items.nx: Close the 2025 income statement once the auditor has confirmed the closing balances.

open_items.d: Payroll, materials, depreciation, premises costs and interest are not posted for September. See checklist.
open_items.nx: Post payroll and materials, run depreciation and record accrued costs.

open_items.d: SR00089 and SR00110, ISK 50.0m each excl. VAT (62.0m incl. VAT), both dated Sunday 23 Aug 2026 for the same milestone.
open_items.nx: Compare with the job contract and progress. If duplicated: credit note on one and a revenue correction.

open_items.d: Receivable accounts are higher than the ageing. Manual entries directly on 6310–6330 do not appear on any customer.
open_items.nx: Trace the manual entries (LEIÐR, MILLIF 30 Sep) and post them through the customer.

open_items.d: Debit and credit do not balance within the months (+2.4m and −2.4m).
open_items.nx: Find the document and reverse it with the correct dates.

open_items.d: Revenue on 1110 posted through a journal (source code FHFBOK) in monthly totals, not from sales invoices.
open_items.nx: Get the sales breakdown behind each entry and reconcile to invoices. A second person approves journals.

open_items.d: {inv_n:n} purchase invoices ({inv_sum}m) await approval; {inv_od_n:n} of them are past due.
open_items.nx: Approve or reject those that are due and post them so the liability and cost show.

open_items.d: Last reconciliation 31 Aug 2026. Landsbankinn has an outstanding item (salaries paid 31 Aug) from the last statement.
open_items.nx: Reconcile all six accounts for September and then October.

open_items.d: Account 6340 unchanged since 31 Aug although the card balance rose monthly Jan–Aug.
open_items.nx: Get card statements for Sep–Oct and post them.

open_items.d: Balance on 9110 unchanged since 31 Aug; two repayments of 1.25m are missing.
open_items.nx: Post repayments and interest per the loan statement.

open_items.d: Receivable SR00088, EUR 210,000, stands at the posting rate. The EUR rate is missing in BC after 14 Sep.
open_items.nx: Update the exchange rate table and run currency revaluation before the end of September.

open_items.d: Open supplier entries are higher than liability accounts 9410–9440.
open_items.nx: Find the entry missing from the ledger (credit memo) and correct it.

open_items.d: DT's receivable from Eyjavör (K110) 0.37m and a management fee of 2.4m a month.
open_items.nx: Reconcile intercompany balances and transactions with Eyjavör's books before the group close.

open_items.d: Posting allowed in all periods, including 2025, in G/L setup and for all users.
open_items.nx: Set “Allow posting from” to the first open month once August and September are closed.

rec_rows.d: Five accounts agree to the króna. {lb_name}: statement {lb_stmt}m, bank ledger {lb_ledger}m; one outstanding item (salaries paid 31 Aug) awaits the next statement.

Ageing ISK {ag_total}m, receivable accounts 6310–6330 ISK {krofur_gl}m. The ledger is higher than the subledger: manual entries directly on receivable accounts (LEIÐR, MILLIF 30 Sep).
Open entries ISK {ven_total:2}m, accounts 9410–9440 ISK {ap_gl:2}m. The subledger is higher than the ledger.
Net VAT payable ISK {vsk_net}m. Settlement account 9570 stands at ISK {vsk9570}m debit because settlement entries are missing. Jul–Aug ISK {vsk_julagu}m, due 5 Oct, no payment posted.

DT's receivable from Eyjavör (K110) 0.37m and a management fee of 2.4m a month. Not confirmed against the counterparty's books.

names.Húsnæðiskostnaður (3010–3070) og vaxtagj: Premises costs (3010–3070) and interest (4220) not posted. Record accrued costs. Estimated from August.
